## 1. Developer Heritage & Township Genesis

Kolte-Patil Developers Ltd. (KPDL) is a premier publicly listed real estate enterprise in India (NSE: KOLTEPATIL, BSE: 532924). Established in 1991, Kolte-Patil has shaped the Pune and Western India skyline for over three decades, delivering over 25 million square feet of residential, commercial, and retail developments.

In 2008, Kolte-Patil conceptualized 'Life Republic'—a grand vision of a 390-acre self-sustaining, sovereign township situated at the intersection of Pune's premier IT corridor (Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park, Hinjewadi) and the scenic Western Ghats foothills. The master plan was crafted in collaboration with internationally acclaimed architect Hafeez Contractor.

Today, Life Republic is home to more than 20,000 residents across 12,000+ homes, featuring operational multi-disciplinary infrastructure:
- Operational Crimson Anisha Global School (ICSE/CBSE).
- Captive Government-Recognized Fire Station inside the township.
- 150-ft Wide Arterial Spine Road connecting Hinjewadi Phase 1 & 2 directly to Tathawade and the Pune-Bangalore Highway.
- Dedicated 3.5-Acre Central Urban Lung and Botanical Park.
- High-Street Retail Commercial Hubs, Cafes, and Essential Services.
- Advanced Waste Management, Dual-Plumbing Greywater Systems, and Solar-Assisted Common Lighting.

## 3. Location, Commute & Regional Macro-Economics

### 3.1 Hinjewadi IT Park (Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park)
- Life Republic shares an immediate border with Hinjewadi, Asia's foremost IT and tech innovation corridor.
- Home to 400+ multinational tech giants including Infosys, Wipro, Tata Consultancy Services, Cognizant, Tech Mahindra, Capgemini, Barclays, Synechron, and Mindtree.
- Over 450,000 IT and engineering professionals work within a 5-15 minute radius of the township.

### 3.2 Commute Timings
- Hinjewadi Phase 1: 8 - 10 minutes (via Marunji Spine Road)
- Hinjewadi Phase 2: 12 minutes
- Hinjewadi Phase 3: 15 minutes
- Wakad / Bhumkar Chowk: 12 - 14 minutes
- Baner / Balewadi High Street: 18 - 22 minutes
- Mumbai-Pune Expressway: 10 - 12 minutes
- Pune Railway Station: 40 minutes
- Pune International Airport: 50 minutes

### 3.3 Pune Metro Line 3 Impact
- The 23.3 km Pune Metro Line 3 (HinJawadi to Shivajinagar Civil Court) features 23 elevated stations.
- Stations at Megapolis Circle, Infosys Phase 2, and Hinjewadi Phase 1 reduce the transit time to Central Pune from 60 minutes to just 25 minutes.
- Commercial operation represents an immediate 15% - 25% capital appreciation catalyst for Life Republic.
